jobs.description:
Bring your life 
Are you passionate about developing products where safety, engineering excellence, and user experience come together? Are you excited about developing innovative, safe, and functional solutions for families who love outdoor adventures? If you're driven by the challenge of designing products that combine cutting-edge technology with the highest standards of safety and comfort for children, then this is the perfect opportunity for you! 
As part of our Active with Kids category, you'll contribute to solutions that combine thoughtful design, engineering excellence, and industry-leading safety. With an exciting product portfolio and roadmap ahead, you'll help to shape the next generation of strollers that make adventures with kids safer, easier, and more enjoyable. 
 
What you'll do at Thule 
As a Mechanical Design Engineer - Active with Kids, you'll be part of our committed engineering team specifically developing strollers. Together, we take ideas from concept to finished product through a structured and collaborative development process. 
In this role, you will design and develop components in CAD, create high-quality technical specifications, and collaborate closely with engineering colleagues, project managers, simulation and test engineers, and prototype specialists to solve technical challenges and ensure every detail meets the high standards and requirements. 
You will take an active role in ordering and evaluating prototypes, analyzing test results, and using simulations to verify the strength and performance of your designs. 
In addition, you will document technical solutions, manage design-related risks, and contribute to engineering best practices. Leading and supporting design reviews will be an important part of your role, helping ensure our products meet the highest standards of safety, quality, and sustainability. 
 
What you bring 
To succeed in this role, we believe you have a university degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field, combined with some years of experience in mechanical design and product development. 
You have worked with a variety of materials and understand how to optimize designs for functionality, durability, and safety. Experience from consumer products, the automotive industry, or other safety-critical applications is highly valuable. You have experience working with plastic components and understand their manufacturing processes. You are fluent in both Swedish and English. 
As the role includes practical elements, we believe you thrive in a hands-on product development environment. As a person, you are self-driven, structured, and solution-oriented, with the ability to turn ideas into robust and well-engineered products. You are a team player who enjoys collaborating across disciplines and can effectively manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously. 
 
Why you should join Thule 
At Thule, we are Proud to Be Thule. We believe anything is possible when we stay curious, take initiative and challenge ourselves. We encourage everyone to take ownership and make the most of their part of the business. 
We believe we win as a team by collaborating across functions, sharing knowledge and supporting one another. United by our passion for our products, the outdoors and the Thule brand, we take pride in what we do and create a culture where everyone contributes, grows and has fun. 
 
Hiring Process 
Apply by submitting your application and resumé through “Apply for position” on our Thule Career Site. The application deadline is December 6, 2026. 
Please make sure to not wait to show your interest until the last application date as interviews are held continuously during the process, and the position might be filled before the last application date. Please also note that we do not accept applications by e-mail. 
If you have any questions about the role, feel free to contact our Talent Acquisition Partner, Oscar Persson, at Oscar.persson@thule.com 
We look forward to hearing from you! 
Thule is a global sports and outdoor company. We offer high-quality products with smart features and a sustainable design that make it easy for people across the globe to live an active life. Under the motto Bring your life — and with a focus on consumer-driven innovation and long-term sustainability — we develop, manufacture and market products within the product categories Sport & Cargo Carriers (roof racks, roof boxes and carriers for transporting cycling, water and winter sports equipment, and rooftop tents mounted on a car), Active with Kids & Dogs (car seats, strollers, bike trailers, child bike seats and dog transport), RV Products (awnings, bike carriers and tents for RVs and caravans) and Bags & Mounts (backpacks, luggage and performance mounts).
Thule Group has about 3,000 employees at nine production facilities and 35 sales offices worldwide. The Group’s products are sold in 138 markets and in 2025, sales amounted to SEK 10,4 billion.

Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries.
The position
As a Clinical Evaluator at Cambio, you will play an important role in ensuring that our medical devices are supported by robust clinical evidence and meet applicable requirements for clinical safety and performance.
You will independently plan and conduct clinical evaluations while working closely with a cross-functional Clinical Evaluation Team combining expertise in the device, its intended use and the relevant clinical area. You will collaborate with colleagues across Regulatory Affairs, Risk Management, Post-Market Surveillance, R&D, Product Management and Marketing.
The role gives you the opportunity to work across the medical device lifecycle and contribute to both regulatory compliance and the continued development of our clinical evaluation processes.
Your responsibilities will include:

Plan, conduct and maintain clinical evaluations throughout the medical device lifecycle

Develop and maintain Clinical Evaluation Plans and Clinical Evaluation Reports

Conduct systematic literature reviews and critically assess clinical data and scientific evidence

Evaluate clinical safety, performance and benefit-risk, integrating evidence from risk management, verification and validation, usability and other relevant activities

Monitor emerging clinical evidence, identify residual clinical uncertainties and recommend, develop and conduct appropriate Post-Market Clinical Follow-up activities

Support regulatory submissions and interactions with notified bodies

 We offer:

The opportunity to work with state-of-the-art medical software that helps shape the future of healthcare

Challenging and evolving clinical work as new technologies, including AI, raise the bar for clinical evidence, safety and performance

The chance to influence how clinical evaluations are conducted at Cambio and contribute to the continued development of our clinical strategy

 About you
You have a strong scientific and analytical mindset and are comfortable working with complex clinical information and turning it into clear, well-founded conclusions.
You are quality-conscious and attentive to detail, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of your responsibilities. At the same time, you enjoy working as part of a team and collaborating with people from different areas of expertise. You are a clear and adaptable communicator, able to explain complex topics in a simple and understandable way depending on your audience.
At Cambio, we value initiative and personal growth. Our culture is built on Trust, Care and Together, and it is important that you recognize yourself in these values. 
Requirements 

Experience working with clinical evaluation of medical devices, either leading or contributing to the clinical evaluation process

Experience working with the EU Medical Device Regulation (MDR) and relevant guidance documents

Experience in systematic literature reviews and critical appraisal of clinical and scientific data

Good understanding of clinical safety, performance and benefit-risk assessment

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and good communication skills in Swedish

It's a bonus if you

Have experience working with medical device software

Have experience with Post-Market Surveillance (PMS), Post-Market Clinical Follow-up (PMCF) or risk management

Have experience with clinical research methodology, clinical investigation design or biostatistics

Have experience assessing state of the art, benchmark devices or equivalence

Have experience with scientific literature databases such as Embase or Medline

Additional information:
Place of employment: Linköping or Stockholm
Scope: Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office)
Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period
Additional Information: The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate.
We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link.
We look forward to receiving your application!

Would you like to help develop the next generation of birch forests? Join our research team and investigate how flowering and seed production can support faster progress in forest tree breeding.
Improved planting material contributes to productive and resilient forests. In silver birch, efficient breeding and reliable seed production depend on our ability to understand and influence flowering. Skogforsk is seeking a motivated PhD student to investigate these processes and develop methods that can be applied in breeding programmes and seed production.
The position is part of Phase II of Trees For Me, a centre of excellence focusing on fast-growing broadleaved trees for sustainable forests, materials and energy.

Research project and duties
The overall aim of this four-year PhD project is to improve our understanding of flowering in silver birch and develop practical methods to promote early and reliable flowering and seed production.
The project will investigate how environmental conditions and cultivation treatments influence flowering in young plants and older breeding material. Particular attention will be given to light conditions, plant development and genetic differences in flowering responses. The research will connect fundamental questions about reproductive development with practical challenges in birch breeding.
Earlier flowering could shorten the breeding cycle and help realise the benefits of genomic selection by allowing selected individuals to be crossed at a younger age. Improved control of flowering could also support more reliable seed production.
Your work will include:
Planning, establishing and managing experiments in controlled environments, greenhouses and, where relevant, the field.
Assessing growth, development, male and female flowering, and seed production and quality.
Analysing experimental data using statistical methods.
Publishing scientific papers and communicating results to researchers, breeders and other stakeholders.
Completing doctoral courses in forest genetics, breeding and related subjects.

The detailed research questions and experimental programme will be developed together with the supervisory team.

Trees For Me – Phase II
Trees For Me brings together universities, research institutes, industry and public-sector organisations to develop knowledge and solutions for the sustainable use of fast-growing broadleaved trees, including birch, poplar and aspen.
Within Phase II, this PhD project will contribute knowledge and methods to strengthen birch breeding and the supply of improved reproductive material. The student will participate in an interdisciplinary research environment and collaborate with researchers and stakeholders across the forest sector.

Research environment
The project is a collaboration between Skogforsk and the Southern Swedish Forest Research Centre at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) in Alnarp. The student will be employed by Skogforsk and based at the Ekebo research station in Svalöv, with doctoral enrolment at SLU.
You will join a team working with forest tree genetics, breeding and seed production. The position offers close contact with operational breeding, access to experimental facilities and breeding material, and opportunities for national and international collaboration.

Qualifications
We are looking for a motivated and curious candidate with a master’s degree in forestry, biology, plant science, genetics, environmental science or an equivalent subject relevant to the project.
You should have an interest in experimental research, plant development and the practical application of scientific results. Good communication skills and proficiency in spoken and written English are essential.
The following qualifications are considered merits:
Knowledge of plant physiology, flowering biology, forest genetics or tree breeding.
Experience in establishing and managing plant experiments.
Experience in statistical analysis and programming in R or equivalent software.
Experience working with plants in greenhouses, controlled environments or field trials.

You should be able to work independently and collaboratively, organise your work carefully and take responsibility for practical experiments. A valid driving licence is required.
Applicants must meet SLU’s requirements for admission to doctoral studies.

Employment and application
Employment: Four-year, fixed-term employment as a PhD student at Skogforsk.
Location: Ekebo research station, Svalöv, Sweden.
Starting date: By agreement.
Application deadline: 6 December.
Your application should include:
A cover letter describing your motivation, relevant experience and research interests.
A CV.Degree certificates and transcripts.
Contact details for two referees.

Send your application to eva.persson@skogforsk.se, using the subject line “PhD application – birch”. Deadline for application is 6th of December.
For further information, please contact Mateusz Liziniewicz (mateusz.liziniewicz@skogforsk.se), Researcher, Skogforsk.

About Skogforsk
Skogforsk is the Swedish forestry research institute. Our vision is "World-class forestry for sustainable development." We develop and communicate knowledge, services, and products that contribute to the sustainable development of forestry for the benefit of society.
We operate at three locations: Uppsala, Sävar in Västerbotten, and Ekebo in Skåne. In total, we have approximately 160 employees.
At Ekebo, our research includes forest tree breeding, genetics and the production of improved planting material.

Unit for Field-based Forest Research
Would you like to take on a key leadership role, guiding a dedicated team and contributing to the future of field-based forest research? With us, you will have the opportunity to work outdoors in spectacular natural surroundings and help develop groundbreaking projects addressing forest ecosystem and climate-related issues.
We are looking for a hands-on professional with research experience and leadership skills to lead operations at the Siljansfors and Jädraås Experimental Forests, as well as serve as a member of the management team for the entire Unit for Field-Based Forest Research. This position offers excellent opportunities for someone who enjoys a varied range of responsibilities, thrives on challenges, and wants to contribute to research on boreal forest production and forest ecosystems.
In 2024, the Unit revised its strategic operational plan through to 2030, resulting in a partially new organisation structure that has recently been implemented. In line with the Faculty’s ambition to broaden its activities, the Unit’s remit is also being gradually expanded. This calls for a cohesive and functional organisation across the Unit, structured around its four main areas of activity: long-term experiments, major research infrastructure, commissioned projects, and environmental monitoring and analysis.
About the position
You will be a member of the Unit’s management team. As manager of the Siljansfors and Jädraås Experimental Forests, you will have overall responsibility for operations within your area of responsibility (Svealand and southern Norrland), including financial and personnel management, as well as occupational health and safety matters. Your role is to ensure that activities at the experimental forests develop in a way that best supports field research, environmental monitoring, and education, while remaining within the allocated budget. Cooperation within SLU and engagement with the surrounding community are also ongoing aspects of the station managers responsibilities.
As the station manager, you will work together with your colleagues to ensure that ongoing forest field experiments are maintained and revised according to plan, using modern technology, and that new experiments are established today to address future research questions. You will be responsible for the content of metadata databases and the databases associated with them. You will also be responsible for ensuring that the Siljansfors team actively participates in the steering groups for the Unit’s various main areas of activity, and that the tasks agreed upon by these groups are implemented within your area of responsibility. An important part of the role involves receiving requests and, whenever possible, carrying them out. These may concern the establishment or revision of forest field experiments, environmental monitoring assignments, as well as teaching or outreach activities.
During the snow-free season, you will also participate in practical fieldwork, which involves spending considerable time outdoors and undertaking shorter periods of work-related travel. 
Your profile
Requirements:
Higher education in forestry, preferably supplemented by doctoral studies or other relevant experience in academic work, and a good understanding of the conditions and requirements of research
Extensive experience with practical fieldwork in forest environments
The ability to organise and structure work, and to act in an educational and diplomatic manner
A valid category B driver’s license
Good command of both Swedish and English

Desirable Qualifications:
Management experience, including personnel responsibility
Practical experience in forestry operations and forest inventory
Experience working with databases, GIS data, and related software
Familiar with methods and techniques for tree measurement and field data collection
Experience with meteorological instruments and data loggers

We place great importance on your personal qualities. Of particular importance is your ability to handle unexpected situations, for example when new tasks need to be undertaken at short notice. The position is based at the Siljansfors experimental forest office in central Mora, and at the field station in Siljansfors, 18 km southwest of Mora. SLU’s Faculty of Forest Sciences is located in Umeå.

jobs.description:
We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups - and we’re just getting started.

With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future -  and we want you to be part of it. 

About the Team
The Electromechanics Design Department within Global Robotics R&D Technology consists of 16 engineers specializing in verification, mechanics, mechatronics, and electronics. We are responsible for the electromechanical systems used in our robotic mower platforms and work across the complete product lifecycle, from technology investigations and feasibility studies to product development projects and maintenance activities.
Our team defines system requirements, drives technical coordination across disciplines, and leads verification and validation activities in close collaboration with software, electronics, sourcing, quality, and manufacturing teams.
We offer an international and collaborative working environment characterized by openness, professionalism, and a strong passion for technology and innovation.

About the role
We are looking for a Design Engineer with experience in electrical and/or electromechanical component development to strengthen our electromechanics team.
In this role, you will play a key part in the development of future robotic platforms and act as a technical contributor and coordinator in cross-functional projects. Depending on experience, the role may also include technical leadership responsibilities.
The primary focus of the role is the development and management of Power Supply Units (PSUs), including PSUs both with and without communication interfaces. Responsibility also includes other electrical components such as wiring harnesses, user interface hardware, connectors, and related electromechanical subsystems.
Development activities are carried out in close collaboration with both internal stakeholders and external development partners and suppliers.

Your responsibilities will include:
Development, specification, and integration of power supply units and other electrical components
Defining component requirements and securing technical compliance throughout the product lifecycle
Coordinating development activities in tight cooperation with suppliers and external engineering partners
Leading technical investigations, concept evaluations, and feasibility studies
Cross-functional coordination in tight cooperation with mechanics, electronics, sourcing, quality, manufacturing, and others
Planning and execution of verification and validation activities
Driving continuous improvements in development methodologies, processes, and engineering tools
Supporting technology roadmaps and future platform strategies within electrical systems and components

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent
About 3 years of relevant industrial experience
Experience in product development involving electrical or electromechanical systems

You will work across both nursing home and home care services, giving you the opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills. You will follow patients over time, make independent clinical assessments and work closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
Jondal is a small community in the Hardanger region on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. Here, you will live by the Hardangerfjord, surrounded by mountains, with Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, just 19 kilometres away.
Moving to another country is a big step, and we will support you throughout the process. Dignus Medical provides free Norwegian language training, assistance with Norwegian authorisation and practical support with relocation and settling into your new community.

As a nurse in Jondal, you will work with patients with different healthcare and care needs, both in a nursing home and in their own homes.
The role gives you a high degree of professional responsibility and the opportunity to follow patients over time, while working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
Your responsibilities will include:
Providing nursing care and following up patients
Clinical observation, assessment and documentation
Medication management and treatment
Providing care to patients in nursing homes and in their own homes
Making independent clinical assessments
Working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
Communicating with relatives and other parts of the healthcare service

You:
Hold a valid nursing licence from an EU/EEA country
Hold citizenship from an EU/EEA country
Speak English fluently and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian
Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language programme before starting work
Hold a valid driving licence
Work well both independently and as part of a team
Preferably have experience from community healthcare, nursing homes or home care services

We help you prepare for working in Norway

Free online Norwegian language training with a private teacher
Language training up to the required B2 level, including Norwegian for healthcare professionals
Assistance with your application for Norwegian nursing authorisation
Guidance with the documentation and administrative processes required before starting work
Help with finding accommodation and practical aspects of relocating to Norway
Personal follow-up before, during and after your move

A permanent position in the Norwegian municipal healthcare system

The opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills
Independent professional responsibility
Close cooperation with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
The opportunity to follow patients over time

It is a small community of around 400 people, situated directly by the Hardangerfjord and surrounded by mountains. Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, is only 19 kilometres away.
Nature is part of everyday life here. After work, you can hike in the mountains, kayak or fish on the fjord, or simply enjoy the quiet surroundings. In winter, the area offers excellent opportunities for skiing and other outdoor activities.
Despite its small size, Jondal has the essentials you need for everyday life, including a grocery store, places to eat and local cultural and leisure activities. If you are moving with your family, Jondal has both a kindergarten and a school for children from primary through lower secondary level, as well as a library, swimming pool and sports facilities. Odda is around 40 minutes away by car, while Bergen offers a larger city environment and an international airport.
Interested in starting a new chapter in Norway?
Feel free to get in touch for further information, or send us your application.

On behalf of Ullensvang Municipality, we are recruiting nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Utne, Western Norway.
As a nurse in Utne, you will work across both nursing home and home care services. You will meet patients with different healthcare needs, take independent professional responsibility and work closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
Utne is a small community in the Hardanger region on Norway’s west coast, around 2.5 hours from Bergen and Bergen International Airport. Located by the Sørfjord, a branch of the famous Hardangerfjord, Utne is surrounded by mountains, fruit orchards and some of Western Norway’s most characteristic scenery.
Moving to another country is a big step, and we will support you throughout the process. Dignus Medical provides free Norwegian language training, assistance with Norwegian authorisation and practical support with relocation and settling into your new community.
About the position
As a nurse in Utne, you will have a varied working day and the opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills. Some patients will be cared for in a nursing home, while others receive care in their own homes.
You will work independently and make professional assessments, while also being part of a team and working closely with other healthcare professionals.
Your responsibilities will include:
Providing nursing care and following up patients
Clinical observation, assessment and documentation
Medication management and treatment
Providing care to patients in nursing homes and in their own homes
Making independent clinical assessments
Working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
Communicating with relatives and other parts of the healthcare service

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for qualified nurses who are confident in their professional role, comfortable working independently and motivated to build a new life and career in Norway.
You:
Hold a valid nursing licence from an EU/EEA country
Hold citizenship from an EU/EEA country
Speak English fluently and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian
Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language programme before starting work
Hold a valid driving licence
Work well both independently and as part of a team
Preferably have experience from community healthcare, nursing homes or home care services

We help you prepare for working in Norway
You do not need to speak Norwegian when you apply. If you are selected for the position, Dignus Medical will guide you through the entire process of preparing for your move to Norway.
We provide:
Free online Norwegian language training with a private teacher
Language training up to the required B2 level, including Norwegian for healthcare professionals
Assistance with your application for Norwegian nursing authorisation
Guidance with the documentation and administrative processes required before starting work
Help with finding accommodation and practical aspects of relocating to Norway
Personal follow-up before, during and after your move

The language training and authorisation process take place before you start working, so you have time to prepare both professionally and practically for your new life in Norway.
What you can expect in Utne
A permanent position in the Norwegian municipal healthcare system
Varied work across nursing home and home care services
The opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills
Independent professional responsibility
Close cooperation with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
The opportunity to follow patients over time
Support with housing, relocation and practical arrangements

Life in the heart of Hardanger
Utne is located by the Sørfjord in Hardanger on Norway’s west coast, surrounded by mountains and fruit orchards. Fruit growing has been part of life here for generations, and the landscape changes with the seasons, from orchards in full bloom in spring to apples, plums, pears and cherries later in the year.
Life here is quieter than in a large city, with the fjord and mountains right outside your door. You can spend your free time hiking, exploring the fjord or discovering local farms and producers. Utne also has a strong cultural heritage, including the Hardanger Folk Museum and the historic Utne Hotel.
If you are moving with your family, there is a kindergarten in Utne and a primary school with after-school care nearby. Odda, the main town and administrative centre of Ullensvang Municipality, is around 45 minutes away by car and offers a wider range of shops and services. Ferry connections link Utne to both sides of the fjord, making it easy to explore Hardanger and travel onwards towards Voss and Bergen. Bergen, the largest city in Western Norway, is around 2.5 hours away and has an international airport.
Interested in starting a new chapter in Norway?
Feel free to get in touch for further information, or send us your application.

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. Design Engineer, Volvo Construction Equipment
Would you like to help develop the construction equipment of the future? Together, we create world leading products in the premium segment, with a focus on quality, safety and care for the environment. We are looking for Design Engineers to join the Exterior department at Volvo Construction Equipment in Braås. This position is located on-site in Braås outside Växjö.
About us 
Volvo CE in Braås, near Växjö, developes articulated haulers and wheel loaders and manufactures articulated haulers. Our development departments are constantly working on innovative solutions and designs for new products. All to ensure that we remain at the forefront of development and pushing limits, regarding new product and feature development, product improvements and aftermarket quality.
You will join a global team of skilled professionals who work closely with colleagues in production, purchasing, aftermarket and also with our chosen suppliers. 
With production located at the same site, you will have the opportunity to follow your design solutions from development through to the finished product. 
About the role
As a Design Engineer, you will work with the mechanical design of components and solutions in plastics, sheet metal and tubular structures for wheel loaders and articulated haulers. You will contribute to product development and improvement work in collaboration with colleagues and other functions, taking responsibility for the quality of the team’s deliveries.You will work closely with Product Design in Gothenburg to bring new design languages to our machines. This calls for a strong understanding of plastics, sheet metal and tubular structures, and how to translate design concepts into functional, manufacturable solutions. You will also take the lead on design-related topics and act as a point of contact for other departments. By driving collaboration, coordinating discussions and working across functions, you will help ensure that the team’s deliverables are completed successfully. Your work will focus on exterior components for wheel loaders and articulated haulers.
Who are you?
You enjoy combining technical expertise with an open and solution-oriented approach. You are positive, flexible and a team player with an interest in innovation and product development. You are keen to learn and develop, both individually and as part of a team, and are willing to take the lead when needed. You are comfortable taking initiative and stepping forward when the situation calls for it. You communicate clearly and enjoy working across departmental boundaries, while taking responsibility for the team’s shared deliverables.
You have:
B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Mechanical Engineering or an equivalent qualification
Experience in mechanical design
Strong communication skills in Swedish and English, both spoken and written
Experience with Creo or another 3D modelling tool

 
Experience or knowledge in any of the following areas is an advantage:
Construction equipment or heavy vehicles
Design of sheet metal, plastics or tubular components
FEM calculations
Lean and Agile ways of working

Ready for the next move?
As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable. Last application day November 29.

Are you passionate about test automation, cutting-edge technology, and building reliable solutions? Take on a key role in developing and improving quality assurance for advanced financial crime prevention platforms at one of the Nordic region’s largest banks. Join a collaborative team where your expertise in automation, data testing, and AI-driven testing approaches will make a real impact!
About the position
Perido are looking for an experienced Senior Test Automation Engineer for our client, one of the largest banks in the Nordic region. The position is based at the bank’s office just north of Stockholm.
Your daily tasks
In this role, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of the platforms and detection capabilities used to prevent financial crime. The environment includes cloud-native data pipelines, rule-based detection, APIs, integrations, and real-time data flows on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who combines strong test automation and data-testing expertise with modern AI-assisted and agentic testing approaches. You will work closely with developers, Business Analysts, Requirement Engineers, and architects to build quality into the development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a separate final step.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain automated tests using Python and/or Java and appropriate test automation frameworks
Apply AI-assisted and agentic testing approaches to improve test design, generation, execution, analysis, and maintenance
Test data pipelines, ETL processes, data quality, and data transformations across GCP
Validate rule-based detection engines and complex business logic used in Financial Crime Prevention
Test APIs, integrations, and real-time data flows across distributed systems
Define and continuously improve test strategy, regression coverage, integration testing, and end-to-end testing
Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and development workflows
Ensure AI-generated test assets and results are appropriately reviewed, validated, traceable, and reproducible
Identify quality risks early and work closely with the team to resolve them
Promote good testing practices and support the wider team in continuously improving quality engineering

Your characteristics
We are looking for someone who is analytical, proactive and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of responsibility and a genuine interest in quality and continuous improvement. You are comfortable taking initiative, solving complex problems and working independently, while also enjoying close collaboration with others. You have a structured approach to your work and the ability to communicate technical matters clearly to different stakeholders.
Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!
Please submit your application for this role in English.
Qualifications:
8–10+ years of relevant experience in test automation, technical testing, quality engineering, or testing of complex software systems
Strong hands-on experience designing and implementing test automation solutions and frameworks
Strong programming skills in Python and/or Java, together with good SQL knowledge
Practical experience with AI-assisted or agentic testing, including the use of AI or agents within the software testing lifecycle
Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, preferably including technologies such as BigQuery, Bigtable, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Composer
Strong experience in data, ETL, and data quality testing
Experience testing rule-based systems, decision engines, or complex business logic
Good understanding of APIs, system integrations, CI/CD, and end-to-end testing
Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to understand relationships between data, technology, business requirements, and controls
A proactive, delivery-focused mindset, with the ability to take ownership and work effectively in a cross-functional agile team
Strong communication and documentation skills
A B.Sc., M.Sc., Ph.D., or equivalent relevant education and professional experience

 
Advantageous:
Experience within banking, Financial Crime Prevention, transaction monitoring, compliance, or another regulated environment
Experience applying AI-enabled development or testing tools in professional software engineering
ISTQB or similar testing certification
Google Cloud certification
Requirements Engineering certification, such as REQB or equivalent
